title: Final Exams and a School Sleepover
overview: Nene's life may be coming to an end, but school has her more worried than death.

title: The Near Shore and the Far Shore
overview: Nene and Akane race to rescue Aoi, only to land in hot water themselves.

title: The Reaper's Sacrifice
overview: Nene and friends find Aoi, but she doesn't seem quite her usual self.

title: Sumire
overview: Nene and Hanako find themselves in an unfamiliar place. A strange girl rescues them from masked villagers.

title: Aoi and Akane
overview: While Nene and Hanako get their bearings, Aoi and Akane grapple with more personal problems.

title: Severance
overview: Hanako grants Nene's wish, and she's not happy about how. Now she faces a world without apparitions.

title: Encounters
overview: Nene and Kou retrace Mitsuba's footsteps, looking for a way back to the Boundary.

title: The Red House
overview: Nene and Kou may have found the clue they're looking for in a cursed house. But can they leave with it alive?

title: The Curse
overview: While Teru hunts for clues at a local shrine, Nene scrambles to escape an eerily familiar cave.

title: Tsukasa and Amane
overview: Kou believes they can make everything right by rescuing four-year-old Tsukasa from the Red House.

title: One-way Train to the Far Shore
overview: While Nene and friends prepare to enter the Boundary, their friends on the other side run into trouble.

title: Wishes
overview: Nene and Kou scramble to save Hanako from Teru's wrath while the Boundary collapses around them.
